title: SetPlayerHardcore
description: A lightweight plugin that adds commands to manage hardcore on a player to player basis
body:
A minecraft plugin that allows you to set a certain amount of lives for every player.

Features:

- Automatic ban on death

- Perfect for custom challenges and events

Commands:
- /sethardcore <player> - Puts player in hardcore mode **(OP only)**

- /removehardcore <player> - Removes hardcore mode **(OP only)**
